name: ez barbell spider curl
description: A spider curl with an EZ bar, lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swing.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar up toward your face.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
